face.name: 群山之灵
face.text: 任务：使用6个不同类型的随从牌。奖励：阿沙隆。
face.flavorText: 第10天。有个叫布拉玛的始祖龟把尼利，伊莉斯和我带到了山体内的深处。她给我们展示了“熔岩渠”系统，始祖龟就是用它把岩浆运到高处。山里居然还住着一群火山龙！

face.name: Spirit of the Mountain
face.text: Quest: Play 6 minions of unique types. Reward: Ashalon.
face.flavorText: Day 10. A Tortollan named Bralma took Niri, Elise, and I deep into the mountain. She showed us how the Tortollans move lava up from the base of the volcano through a system of “lavaqueducts.” I was shocked to find a pack of Volcanosaurs living there!

policy.rounds: Two independent ordinary three-of-ten choices; duplicate adaptations remain separate ordered attachments.
policy.original: One original board residency; a departed, transformed or recontrolled recipient is never rebound.
policy.completion: One complete ordered permanent player-effect program is installed only after both selected rewards and their reactions.
policy.source: Original physical Battlecry source face persists even if the carrier changes or leaves; one independent program per actual Battlecry.
policy.future_paid: After counter/capacity acceptance, before normal entry or magnetic fusion; one original paid minion.
policy.future_generated: Actual whole-card physical original primary before entry announcement; quantity extras are distinct plain entries, not extra played cards.
policy.ordinary_summons: No new program grant for summons, copies, resurrection, recruit or Colossal appendages.
policy.attachments: Existing ordinary Buff/keyword/deathrattle installers; source and lifespan preserved through existing silence/copy/zone policies.
policy.spores: One modern attributed ordered group of two Plant members using original death position and shared quantities.
policy.remaining: TLC_229 parent Quest is source evidence only; full root consumer still pending.
